name: Circle Mate
source: The protagonist Kenji has chronic headaches, accompanying the headaches he also gets to experience telepathy events. On the surface Kenji is a member of the computer circle in his school. Under the hood he is also attending a secret orgy club. One day Kenji is informed that Jun, who is the top beauty in the school, jumps off the platform and is killed by the train. A detective suspects Kenji to be the culprit of Jun's death, so Kenji starts his own investigation.
translation: 主人公健二长期饱受头痛困扰，每当头痛发作，他还会经历心灵感应般的现象。表面上，健二只是学校电脑社的一员；私下里，他还参加了一个秘密的乱交俱乐部。一天，他得知校内公认的第一美女雾岛纯跳下站台，被列车撞死。一名刑警怀疑健二正是害死纯的凶手，于是健二开始自行调查真相。
